{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|arg= global

|eff= local

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Sets material of object selection. The selection number is defined through the [[CfgVehicles Config Reference#hiddenSelections|hiddenselection]][] = {} array in the vehicle's config (starting with 0).

|s1= obj [[setObjectMaterial]] [selectionNumber, material]

|p1= obj: [[Object]]

|p2= selectionNumber: [[Number]] or [[String]] (since {{GVI|arma3|2.10}}).

|p3= material: [[String]] - material path. Since {{GVI|arma3|2.20}} using '''"#reset"''' would reset to default material.

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
car setObjectMaterial [0,"A3\Structures_F\Data\Windows\window_set.rvmat"];
car setObjectMaterial [1,"A3\Structures_F\Data\Windows\window_set.rvmat"];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getObjectMaterials]] [[setObjectTextureGlobal]] [[getObjectTextures]] [[setObjectTexture]] [[setObjectMaterialGlobal]]
}}
